title: The Path to Paradise
arabic_text: عن [أبي عبدِ اللهِ جابرِ بنِ عبدِ اللهِ الأنصاريِّ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُما، أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ: أَرَأَيْتَ إذا صَلَّيْتُ الْمَكْتُوباتِ، وَصُمْتُ رَمَضَانَ، وَأَحْلَلْتُ الْحَلالَ، وَحَرَّمْتُ الْحَرَامَ، وَلَمْ أَزِدْ عَلَى ذلِكَ شَيْئًا، أَأَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ؟ قالَ: "نَعَمْ".
english_translation: From AbūʿAbd Allāh Jābir bin ʿAbd Allāh al-Ansārī (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhumā), that a man asked the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) and said: Do you consider that if I pray the prescribed prayers, fast in Ramaḍān, treat as lawful what is lawful and treat as unlawful what is unlawful, and I do not add anything else to that, shall I enter Paradise? He (the Messenger) said, 'Yes.'
description: This Hadith describes the path to Paradise as fulfilling the basic obligations: performing the prescribed prayers, fasting in Ramadan, avoiding the unlawful, and accepting the lawful.
